annotations.title: Economics · Adjust a dollar amount for inflation

description:
Move a dollar amount between two periods using the CPI — e.g. a 2021
median into today's dollars, or a past rent by the rents index.
The frequency follows the period format.

**Price: 1¢ per call.**

item.description: CPI item to adjust by, e.g. rents to index a rent.

region.description: One of: australia, sydney, melbourne, brisbane, adelaide, perth, hobart, darwin, canberra.

to_period.description: Same format as from_period. Default: the latest published.
